canonical_question: How much farther can a fresh agent get today than an equally capable fresh agent could get yesterday?
governing_principle: Build systems so intelligence inherits understanding, not just source code.
objective: Measure whether accumulated repository knowledge increases the effective engineering capability of an equally capable zero-context agent without relying on hidden conversational history.

terms.fresh_agent: An agent beginning an evaluation without private project-specific conversational history beyond the declared benchmark input and repository state.
terms.fresh_agent_advancement: The increase in useful engineering distance an equally capable fresh agent can travel with a later repository revision under comparable conditions.
terms.inheritable_technical_knowledge: Engineering knowledge preserved so a new human or agent can discover, interpret, verify, and use it without reconstructing private reasoning.
terms.inheritance_delta: The measurable difference between comparable fresh-agent runs attributable to the repository revision supplied.
terms.frontier_reach: The latest genuine engineering boundary reached under a bounded task and budget.
terms.knowledge_recurrence: The degree to which preserved knowledge benefits later distinct tasks rather than only the run that produced it.
terms.agentic_compounding: A repeated pattern in which completed work leaves reusable knowledge that lowers the cost of later work and lets subsequent agents reach genuinely new problems sooner.
terms.knowledge_escape: A failure of inheritance where previously discovered project knowledge must be reconstructed, found externally, or manually supplied because it was not preserved usefully.
terms.fresh_agent_advancement_benchmark: A controlled comparison using equally capable fresh agents, comparable goals and budgets, and different immutable repository revisions.

anti_claim: This record defines a research direction and benchmark vocabulary. It does not claim that Morphic already demonstrates autonomous self-development or measurable agentic compounding.
portable_hypothesis: If a project makes technical knowledge inheritable by fresh agents, preserves causal evidence, and lets each new agent start farther ahead, the method can potentially be reused outside this repository.
